notes: The verse-final בּוֹ is left wholly unrendered by the ASV, so both its morphemes are unrepresented (rules 40, 22).

The object *it* after *turn* is `added`: no object morpheme stands on the verb (rule 44). The apodosis waw takes the written *then* under rule 14, and the assimilated article of בַּכָּסֶף is unrepresented, *into money* carrying no *the*.
